playbook:
When I must pledge, if I can only afford scout I pledge scout.

When I have ≥2 fuel and need immediate safe points (behind or close), prefer scout early rounds to bank points and conserve fuel.

When I have plenty of fuel (≥2) and both opponents pledged scout (or I expect they will), pledge raid only if I intend and can act raid that round.

Never pledge raid unless I will actually perform the raid (pledge deducts fuel immediately and act must repeat pledge). Do not pledge raid as a bluff.

When I am leading and an opponent to my left (who raids clockwise into me) is likely to raid, pledge escort to block theft.

When tied or slightly behind near late rounds and I can raid to swing the score, pledge raid provided I will act raid that round and have fuel to cover both pledge and expected penalty.

When opponents show mixed signals (some scouts, some escorts) prefer escort if I’m vulnerable, or scout if I want safe points and’m not the raid target.

When submitting my act, always match my pledge.

When everyone pledged scout, prefer raid as an act only if I actually pledged raid; otherwise scout/escort as pledged. Do not switch to raid at the act stage unless I pledged raid.

When fuel is low (0–1), avoid pledging anything but scout; prioritize conserving fuel for end-of-game fuel-to-points conversion.

When deciding raid target value, raid only if the clockwise target is scoring scouts without escort and the swing (±3 points) helps my standing.

If I expect a coordinated two-player raid on one target, use escort to protect that target if it’s me or scout elsewhere if I can’t protect.

If past rounds show opponents habitually scout, plan a timed raid (pledge+act) in a round where I have sufficient fuel to both pay pledge cost and accept potential cost from an escorted defender.

If a previous raid attempt left me with negative or zero usable fuel next rounds, avoid repeating that sequence—maintain positive fuel for final-round leftover point value.

If leading near the end with low fuel, prioritize escort (if vulnerable) or scout to collect guaranteed points and preserve final fuel value rather than risky raids.
